supportingSources.label: Erik Thoren at Great Lakes Open 2021 Classics — Group Matchplay

strategy.summary: Plunge the A lane, repeat the right spinner for M-A-G-I-C and bonus, and use the left spinner to feed the three-bank when its return is controlled.

steps.text: Plunge the orange A lane. Watch which spinner lights for the 1,000-point add-on.
modeNotes: A-lane add-on: The A lane lights one spinner for 1,000 extra points per spin. Slingshot hits move the lit add-on between spinners.
The A plunge also sends the ball from the 1,000-point top bumper toward the drop bank.

steps.text: From the left flipper, shoot the right spinner to send the ball to the top lanes.
modeNotes: Right spinner: A completed shot advances one M-A-G-I-C letter and adds one bonus unit before the ball returns from the top.
Completing M-A-G-I-C raises spinner scoring and can light Extra Ball when the operator enables it.

steps.text: When the right-spinner return is controlled, repeat it. Prefer the spinner that has the lit 1,000-point add-on.
modeNotes: Spinner value: Both spinners start at a lower value. The A-lane add-on and M-A-G-I-C completions raise their scoring.

steps.text: Shoot the left spinner when its feed can reach the upper three-bank. Complete the bank to raise bonus X.
modeNotes: Drop bank: Completing all three lightning-bolt targets raises the end-of-ball bonus multiplier by one step, up to 5x.
The left spinner feeds the upper drop-bank area. Use the feed; do not force a square standup-target hit.

steps.text: Keep raising bonus and spinner value. Collect the upper-left bonus saucer only when a large bonus is ready.
modeNotes: Collect Bonus: The hidden upper-left saucer immediately scores the current bonus. It is mainly reached by a bumper bounce, not a direct shot.
Maximum end-of-ball bonus is 19,000 at 5x, or 95,000.

fallback.title: Drop-bank bonus
fallback.when: Use this route when one or both spinner shots fail to reach the top safely.

steps.text: Use natural top-bumper feeds to finish the three lightning-bolt drop targets.
Complete the bank again when it resets to raise Bonus X toward 5x.
Use safe return lanes and incidental M-A-G-I-C letters to build base bonus. Protect the multiplied bonus.

alternatives.title: Return-lane value
alternatives.when: Use this route when the lower star and return lanes can be reached without an outlane feed.

steps.text: Roll over the red center star. Then use controlled return-lane rolls for points and bonus.
modeNotes: Return-lane value: The center star raises each return lane from 2,000 to 4,000, then 6,000, then 8,000.
Each return lane also advances bonus twice.

steps.text: Stop this route when a return-lane attempt crosses directly into the outlane.
Build base bonus to 19,000 with top lanes, spinners, targets, and return lanes.
Complete the three-bank enough times to reach 5x Bonus X.
Drain without tilting, or collect the upper-left bonus saucer when it appears safely.

quickInfo.name: A lane
quickInfo.summary: The skill shot lights one spinner for a 1,000-point add-on and feeds the top bumper toward the drops.

quickInfo.name: Right spinner
quickInfo.summary: A full right-spinner shot advances M-A-G-I-C, adds bonus, and returns through the top lanes.

quickInfo.name: Left spinner
quickInfo.summary: The left spinner deflects the ball toward the three lightning-bolt drop targets.

quickInfo.name: Three-bank
quickInfo.summary: Each completion scores an escalating award and advances end-of-ball Bonus X toward 5x.

quickInfo.name: Collect Bonus
quickInfo.summary: The upper-left saucer immediately scores the current bonus and is usually reached by bumper action.

techniques.name: A-lane skill shot
techniques.instruction: Plunge the orange A lane. Use it to light the spinner add-on and send the top-bumper rebound toward the drop bank.

techniques.name: Left-spinner bank feed
techniques.instruction: Shoot through the left spinner. Let the upper deflection move the ball toward the three lightning-bolt targets.

techniques.name: Shatz pass
techniques.instruction: Shatz pass into a return lane only after a safe test on this copy; stop after any outlane crossover.

cautions.issue: A spinner attempt that does not reach the top can return toward a drain.
cautions.response: Test both spinner power requirements. Use the drop-bank fallback when either spinner repeatedly rejects the ball.

cautions.issue: The four side G-I-C-M standup targets are high-risk letter shots.
cautions.response: Do not shoot them directly. Take M-A-G-I-C letters from spinner shots and incidental rebounds.

cautions.issue: A return-lane Shatz can continue through the adjacent outlane.
cautions.response: Use the shot only after a safe test. Stop immediately after one inlane-to-outlane feed.

cautions.issue: The upper-left Collect Bonus saucer is not a reliable direct shot.
cautions.response: Do not aim at the surrounding posts. Let pop-bumper action find the saucer after a large bonus is ready.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At the Great Lakes Open 2021, Erik Thoren repeatedly used the lit spinners, completed the three-bank for Bonus X, and collected the built bonus during a 419,000-point game.
At DFW Carpool PinMasters 2025, Robert Byers, Garrett Shahan, Hadi Seyed-Ali, and Brian Hayden repeatedly returned to the lit 1,000-point add-on spinners while using the drop bank for Bonus X.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Magic, plunge the A lane to add 1,000 per spin to one spinner, then shoot the right spinner to advance M-A-G-I-C and return the ball to the top. Repeat the spinner carrying the lit add-on. When the left-spinner feed is controlled, use it to reach the upper three-bank and complete that bank until Bonus X reaches 5x.
strategy.overview: In Magic, the A lane gives one spinner a 1,000-point add-on, right-spinner shots advance M-A-G-I-C, and each upper three-bank completion raises Bonus X. Plunge A, repeat the spinner carrying the add-on, and use the right spinner's top return to continue the loop. Feed the three-bank through the left spinner when safe, build 19,000 base bonus at 5x, and take the upper-left Bonus Collect only when it arrives naturally.
